scenes.title: Claude Code
scenes.sub: Anthropic's agentic coding tool, powered by the Claude model family.
scenes.say: This is Claude, from Anthropic, and Claude Code, its agentic coding tool.

scenes.heading: What it is
bullets: Claude: Anthropic's model family and assistant
Claude Code: an agent that writes code for you
Works in the terminal, the IDE, and desktop
scenes.say: Claude is Anthropic's family of models and its assistant. Claude Code is the agent built on it, for writing and changing code in your terminal, your IDE, or the desktop app.

scenes.heading: How it runs
steps: Claude Code lives in your terminal, IDE, or desktop
Claude models run in Anthropic's cloud
Claude API, AWS, Google Cloud, Azure
scenes.say: Claude Code runs on your machine and calls Claude models in the cloud, through Anthropic's API and apps, or through AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure.

scenes.heading: Timeline
scenes.say: Claude launched in March 2023. Claude Code arrived as a preview in February 2025 and hit 1.0 with Claude 4 that May. The flagship today is Claude Opus 5.5, and Claude Code is on version 2.1.296.
